resources.string: Checks whether a paired device advertises the wireless Android Auto service over Bluetooth. Read-only: it asks the device which services it offers and connects to nothing.\n\nHave the truck on and connected to this phone over Bluetooth as usual, with the USB cable unplugged. Then tap the truck below. Each run is saved as a report; use Export saved reports on the main screen to take it off the phone.
Asking %1$s for its services… (up to 15 s)
Verdict: %1$s. Not saved: the report store is not available.
The probe needs Nearby devices. Allow it in Settings, Apps, then reopen the probe.
